newsitem.title: UKRAINE: Ukraine cuts power to 12,300 enterprises--minister.
newsitem.headline: Ukraine cuts power to 12,300 enterprises--minister.

text.p: Ukraine's Energy Ministry has cut off electricity supplies to about 12,300 enterprises for failing to pay their electrical bills, the deputy energy minister said on Tuesday.
"We have cut off 12,300 enterprises because of their electrical debts, although this figure is not set in stone," Volodymyr Darchuk told a news conference.
He said the number of companies with debts for energy supplies was growing. Ministry statistics show 33,000 enterprises owe money for electrical power.
Industrial debts for electricity had grown to 3.9 billion hryvnias ($1.96 million) at the beginning of this year from 2.1 billion hryvnias ($1.06 million) a year ago.
